title_en: Bargain price! At Hora Vertikale, Super Apartment 3+1 for sale, with perfect floor plan!
description_en: Bargain price! At Hora Vertikale, Super Apartment 3+1 for sale, with perfect layout!! The project is characterized by the modern contemporary infrastructure and model of the towers that are currently being built in the central areas of Tirana. The apartment has a total area of ​​151 m2 and is organized with a corridor that divides the living room and kitchen with access to the balcony, a master bedroom with its own toilet, two children's rooms and a day toilet.
